description: Three goals on an arc at equal distance from the start, with the true goal in the middle. Dragan and Srinivasa observe that for a goal in the middle of a scene the most legible trajectory coincides with the predictable one, because any exaggeration points at a different goal: legibility is limited by the complexity of the scene. This scenario exists so the benchmark contains a case where clarity cannot be bought, and pairs with fan_outer, which shares its geometry exactly and differs only in which goal is true.
